mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_task_schedule(id,tenant_id,code,rule_version,rule_json,actor_id,actor_org_id, next_index,next_generate_at,next_attempt_at) VALUES(#{id},#{tenantId},#{code},#{ruleVersion},#{ruleJson},#{actorId},#{actorOrgId}, #{nextIndex},#{nextGenerateAt},#{nextAttemptAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_task_schedule WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND code=#{code} AND rule_version=#{version}
SELECT * FROM sys_task_schedule WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM sys_task_schedule WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id > #{after} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM sys_task_occurrence WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND schedule_id=#{schedule} AND occurrence_index=#{index}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_task_occurrence SET state='GENERATED' WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND state='PENDING'
